findings.finding: All 12 other native evidence entries are byte-identical to the earlier audit; only weather-model entry changed. Duplicate entries refer to shared files. Prior identity, sharing, contacts, provider-auth, local/widget storage, location, ads/consent and purchase findings remain source-supported at this commit. Backend deployment and retention are not reverified.

Existing coordinate-based Apple WeatherKit current/hourly/daily/alerts call remains; coordinate diagnostic output and GPS-only alert-processing branch remain. Changes add request cancellation/timeout/loading state and reuse the returned hourly data as an in-memory map-point forecast. This diff does not introduce a non-Apple provider.

New reachable map card and full-screen viewport load routes request Apple WeatherKit hourly forecasts at computed grid coordinates. Compact grid is3x3 with snapped center; expanded grid7x7 follows viewport scale. These are map sample positions, not necessarily exact GPS coordinates.

Selected place forecast and visible place-list current conditions send corresponding coordinates to Apple WeatherKit. Available places include initial selection, current location if available, and saved regions. Unlike snapped grids, these paths pass the place coordinate directly.

Grid forecasts, coordinates/grid keys and fetched timestamps are Codable and stored as JSON in Caches/WeatherMapForecast-v4.json; memory reuse uses30-minute freshness and pruning after successful fetch, with at most12 retained grids after the conditional eviction. On restore expired entries are filtered in memory. Place forecast/conditions dictionaries are in-memory with30-minute freshness filters.
findings.caution: 30 minutes is a freshness rule, not proof the disk file is deleted within30 minutes. Disk rewrite depends on a later successful request; no provider/server retention claim is justified.

findings.finding: WindMapCanvas configures Apple MapKit MKMapView, including selected region. Natural Earth outlines are decoded from bundled geojson; visible Natural Earth URL is a user-facing attribution Link, not a forecast or background data-fetch endpoint. MapKit network fields/retention cannot be derived exactly from these SDK calls.

Bounded git grep over Calendar/WeatherView for explicit http URLs, URLSession, MKLocalSearch and CLGeocoder found Apple Weather attribution, Natural Earth attribution/license, Apple search/geocoding usage. No Open-Meteo or other non-Apple weather request found in inspected new map/model paths. This is not a whole-app dependency/traffic guarantee.
